docs.title: Home
docs.text:
This is the docs for ProSeka's DN42 Network (AS4242423931)

Welcome!

A small experimental network on DN42, providing transit and services.

Established since 2026, It runs on a few small host, simulating the global internet and connecting people via peering.

All peers are welcomed

docs.title: Resources that are currently in use
Nodes that are operated by ProSeka
docs.text:
None of the nodes has a SLA

Nodes that work one day could fail and/or be removed

Please do not depend on them for emergency purposes

Peering are welcomed!

Latency must be in a acceptable range and not too variable. Please do not flap or you will be de-peered.

CGNATed nodes accepted too.

All nodes are connected to each other via babel and ebgp
